name: Sylvakru
tagline: Play your music from your phone or your own home server
description:
Sylvakru is a music player that works with both the songs stored on your phone and music libraries you run yourself on a home server. It connects to popular self-hosted music servers, so you can stream your own collection from anywhere.

It's built to feel the same whether you're playing a local song or one streamed from your own server.
